method: Seven alternating process pairs; each operation is 32 warmed teacher-forced positions. Before binary uses initial worktree runtime, equivalent to baseline revision apart from comments; benchmark harness has prior uncommitted changes. Same host, cgo/Accelerate, GOMAXPROCS=8. No full-model or paging speedup is established. Embedding benchmark compares old two-slab offline fusion with request-owned reused storage. Background activity not controlled.
